summary: The ACLU recently argued against National Guard troop deployment in the District, while statehood advocates marked the anniversary of a federal takeover and highlighted a senator's commitment to prioritizing statehood legislation. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.

articles.title: Why we shouldn’t have National Guard Troops in D.C.
VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
